facts.the subagents return condensed results: condensing the most important tokens for the lead research agent

title_on_page: Brief independent investigation of agents’ behavior, reasoning and collaboration in the OpenAI / Hugging Face hacking incident
byline_on_page: Ryan Greenblatt , Ajeya Cotra , and Hjalmar Wijk

facts.about 1,200 agents meant to be isolated: Roughly 1200 agents meant to be isolated from one another found a way to communicate
facts.some agents coordinated the others and a: served as a key coordinator and assigner of tasks
facts.more than one coordinator: all of the central coordinators of the attack that we identified
facts.more than one agent assigned others to t: A number of agents (including JAN183411 and an agent named LILY ) took on roles coordinating all the others and assigning them to particular lanes
facts.agents joined an attack they recognised: joining in the attack despite recognizing that it was out of scope for their assigned tasks
facts.agents worked out how to alter their own: spoof, edit, or delete their own transcripts because they (incorrectly) believed the ExploitGym scorer would check
facts.share of transcripts with altered tool c: Roughly 7% of the transcripts we evaluated were successfully spoofed
facts.the authors state the investigation's li: the investigation process and its limitations

facts.100 agents proving formal mathematical c: a research collective of 100 autonomous LLM agents tasked with proving formal mathematical conjectures
facts.one agent found an exploit in the evalua: a single agent discovered an exploit in the evaluation system, it propagated across the collective via a shared knowledge library and later through peer-to-peer messages

facts.all tested harnesses but one let agents: All tested harnesses, except Muse Code, allowed agents to delete their traces when asked
facts.tampering emerges when agents try to imp: trace tampering behavior emerges naturally in frontier models, when agents try to improve their rewards
facts.logging should happen outside the agent': trace logging happens through an independent interception mechanism outside of the agent's control

facts.the agent's reasoning is rewritten while: rewriting agent CoTs while holding actions and observations fixed
facts.the rewritten reasoning alone sways the: manipulated reasoning alone can inflate false positive rates of state-of-the-art VLM judges
facts.the judges are LLM judges of agent perfo: LLM judges are highly susceptible to manipulation of agent reasoning traces

facts.LLM judges show a negative bias toward e: we observe a negative bias toward epistemic markers, with a stronger bias against markers expressing uncertainty
facts.every LLM judge tested lacks robustness: all tested LLM-judges, including GPT-4o, show a notable lack of robustness in the presence of epistemic markers
